'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[2024 Gaza Strip polio epidemic]]
****Six people are injured, including two children, in an [[Israel]]i strike on a [[polio virus|polio]] [[polio vaccine|vaccination]] centre in [[northern Gaza]] as the [[World Health Organization]] vaccination campaign resumes with its second phase. *[[Safety of journalists]]
**[[UNESCO]] reports that the killings of journalists worldwide increased by 38% in 2022–2023, compared to the two previous years, equating to one journalist killed every four days. [https://www.dw.com/en/unesco-reports-surge-in-journalist-killings/a-70666861 (DW)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**At least two people are killed and several others are injured in fights between two [[Somalia|Somali]] security factions in [[Hodan District]], [[Mogadishu]], Somalia. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European floods]]
**[[2024 Spain floods]]
***The death toll from the [[flood]]ing in [[Spain]], primarily in the [[Valencian Community]], increases to 214, with dozens still missing. The [[Spanish government]] deploys an additional 5,000 [[Spanish Armed Forces|soldiers]] and 5,000 [[Law enforcement in Spain|police officers]], making this the country's largest deployment of army and security personnel in peacetime. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/thousands-join-effort-clean-up-catastrophic-spanish-floods-2024-11-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/2/spain-deploys-10000-more-troops-and-police-to-flooded-valencia-region (Al Jazeera)]
*Fourteen people are killed and 34 others are injured in a [[lightning strike]] at the [[Palabek Refugee Settlement]] in [[Lamwo District]], [[Uganda]]. [https://apnews.com/article/uganda-lightning-strike-refugee-camp-82e265b12f2a305befb02011ae43d1af (AP)]
*Six people are killed and five others are injured after an unspecified vehicle collided with a truck in [[Sundargarh District]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/odisha/six-killed-five-injured-as-passenger-vehicle-hits-truck-in-odisha/article68822265.ece (The Hindi)]
*Four people are killed and 17 others are injured when a [[truck]] crashes into several [[Traffic congestion|stopped vehicles]] on [[Interstate 96]] near [[Webberville, Michigan|Webberville]], [[Michigan]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/crash-death-semi-michigan-interstate-police-utility-5807615526a16312b0c546dad05ac95f (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Bolivia protests]]
**The [[government of Bolivia]] accuses supporters of former [[President of Bolivia|President]] [[Evo Morales]] of detaining and holding more than 200 [[Armed Forces of Bolivia|soldiers]] hostage during protests against the sitting [[Luis Arce]] government. [https://www.eldiario.net/portal/2024/11/02/grupos-armados-irregulares-toman-tres-unidades-militares/ (''El Diario'')] [https://www.dw.com/en/bolivia-says-morales-supporters-detained-over-200-soldiers/a-70670672 (DW)]
*[[2024 Botswana general election]]
**[[Duma Boko]] is sworn in as the [[President of Botswana]] following his victory over the former ruling [[Botswana Democratic Party]] in the general election last week. His party, the [[Umbrella for Democratic Change]] party, wins the majority in the [[National Assembly of Botswana|National Assembly]] with 36 seats. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/8/botswana-swears-in-duma-boko-as-new-president (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.mmegi.bw/news/boko-sworn-in-as-president/news (''Mmegi'')]
*[[2024 Conservative Party leadership election]]
**[[Kemi Badenoch]] is [[elect]]ed [[Leader of the Conservative Party (UK)|leader]] of the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]], following the resignation of [[Rishi Sunak]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2024/nov/02/kemi-badenoch-wins-tory-leadership-election (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2024 Mozambican general election]]
**The death toll from police gunfire during crackdowns on protests of the October 9 election increases to eleven. [https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2024/10/31/ready-to-dieprotesters-face-bullets-for-political-change-in-mozambique (Al Jazeera)]
